Title: Implement splitbrain_plan_task tool (decompose goal without executing)
Description: Separate from agent_task. plan_task decomposes a goal into an ordered step list using a reasoning model (deepseek-r1:7b) and returns the plan without executing any steps. Enables human-review-before-execute workflows, especially important for write operations. Pattern: plan_task → human approval → agent_task with plan attached. Routes to Quality/Deep node. Parameters: goal, context?, maxSteps? (default 10).
